connected-github.probe: Perform one bounded connected GitHub read against the exact repository and retain the response identity.
connected-github.description: Connected GitHub inventory and evidence path. Repository visibility does not imply workstation reachability.

singleton-gateway-mcp.probe: Call the singleton gateway environment summary, storage route status and storage write-probe; require the gateway and delegated Local Storage authorities to report current readiness.
singleton-gateway-mcp.description: Canonical authenticated local ingress for governed storage and bounded workstation control. Storage bytes remain owned by Local Storage; the gateway supplies one shared policy/audit boundary and an independent bounded Windows fallback.

local-specialist-mcp.probe: Start the declared local stdio MCP server, complete its handshake and call its bounded status tool.
local-specialist-mcp.description: Narrow local MCP tools for repository, storage, device, testing and computer-control capabilities. For storage mutation, prefer the singleton gateway route when available so all agents share one ingress boundary.

structured-workstation-bridge.probe: Call Workstation Bridge readiness and require the accepted exact source revision and current-user policy identity.
structured-workstation-bridge.description: Primary local structured execution surface for reviewed scripts, typed operations and exact-SHA repository tasks. Generated durable files should be promoted through Local Storage rather than creating a competing byte lifecycle.

durable-local-execution.probe: Create or inspect a bounded durable no-op health job and retain its current worker and journal identity.
durable-local-execution.description: Recoverable long-running local jobs with durable state, cancellation, bounded logs and terminal receipts. Durable output promotion remains a Local Storage responsibility.

openai-secure-mcp-tunnel.probe: Call the registered read-only workstation observer through the Secure MCP Tunnel and verify its current bundle identity.
openai-secure-mcp-tunnel.description: ChatGPT read-only workstation observation path. It is never effectful execution authority.

cloudflare-typed-relay.probe: Verify authenticated typed dispatch readiness, the outbound workstation connection and the current local allowlist revision.
cloudflare-typed-relay.description: Separate authenticated fixed-action remote dispatch. For ChatGPT this is the effectful remote route until an effectful OpenAI MCP transport is explicitly proven; public MCP status remains read-only and redacted.

github-issue-queue.probe: Verify the exact queue schema, author admission, expiry policy, worker revision and replay journal; completion still requires a correlated issue receipt.
github-issue-queue.description: Zero-cost asynchronous fallback for SHA-bound structured requests. Queue acceptance is not evidence that the workstation ran.
